mapper.select: SELECT id, name, amount, stock_symbol AS "stockSymbol", stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", stock_price_usd AS "stockPriceUsd", stock_usd_krw AS "stockUsdKrw", to_char(stock_quote_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "stockQuoteDate", to_char(stock_valued_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "stockValuedAt", to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "updatedAt" FROM asset WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, amount FROM asset WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND stock_symbol IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE asset SET amount = amount + #{delta}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND stock_symbol IS NULL AND amount + #{delta} BETWEEN 0 AND 99999999999
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_symbol AS "stockSymbol", stock_quantity AS "stockQuantity", stock_price_usd AS "stockPriceUsd", stock_usd_krw AS "stockUsdKrw", stock_quote_date AS "stockQuoteDate" FROM asset WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_symbol IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE asset SET amount = #{amount}, stock_price_usd = #{price}, stock_usd_krw = #{rate}, stock_quote_date = #{quoteDate}, stock_valued_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND stock_symbol IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset (user_id, name, amount, updated_at, stock_symbol, stock_quantity, stock_price_usd, stock_usd_krw, stock_quote_date, stock_valued_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{amount}, now(), #{stockSymbol}, #{stockQuantity}, #{stockPriceUsd}, #{stockUsdKrw}, #{stockQuoteDate}, CASE WHEN #{stockSymbol, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() END)
mapper.update: UPDATE asset SET name = #{name}, amount = #{amount}, updated_at = now(), stock_symbol = #{stockSymbol}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, stock_price_usd = #{stockPriceUsd}, stock_usd_krw = #{stockUsdKrw}, stock_quote_date = #{stockQuoteDate}, stock_valued_at = CASE WHEN #{stockSymbol, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() END WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM asset WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
